scope: Historical component diagnostics, not current option-blind relation ablations. No new inference performed for this release.

qwen70.selection: Existing frozen70, 10 per question type; all70 unique rows complete, no error rows in saved file. Prior failed/retried history is not reconstructible from overwritten final JSONL alone.
qwen70.visual_inputs: Stored image metadata matches primary records for all70; original historical frame byte hashes are not certified by this metadata check.
qwen70.protocol: Spatial-only: VLM over frames plus full-run Spatial trace. Social-only: separately compiled from frames/question without Spatial trace, prediction from answer posterior. Joint: saved primary runtime prediction. Not a shared-compilation/shared-final-answerer intervention.
qwen70.candidate_conditioning: query_evidence exists in40/70 Social-only and66/70 joint saved codes; Social-only includes posterior in70/70. Historical candidate-conditioned answer scoring is not current option-blind SSC. This alone is not evidence of gold-label access.
qwen70.cost: Unequal generation/scoring pipelines; matched compute is not claimed.

gemini600.protocol: Offline recomputation of historical frozen evidence. Bare-evidence and shared-scaffold matrices have different common information and must not be pooled.
gemini600.cleanup: The historical recomputation separated neural evidence from cached fused programs to avoid importing a full-method posterior as Social-only evidence.
gemini600.limitation: A deterministic historical candidate/posterior scoring path, not a fresh600 current-model or option-blind endpoint run. The original600 were inspected in development.
gemini600.shared_scaffold_counterexample: Spatial452/600 exceeds joint450/600; retained in this release. Labeled OOF routing is not relabeled plain SSC and not included in the main component rows.

conclusion: Joint point estimates exceed both single components in Qwen70 and Gemini bare-evidence600, but gains over the strongest single component are not significant by the reported exact paired tests. Neither comparison isolates evidence links or agent attribution.
publication_boundary: Export contains per-question labels and predictions plus audit metadata, not full questions, videos, model weights, credentials or raw model reasoning. Offline verifier checks arithmetic/coverage only, not model reruns or semantic correctness of generated code.
